errors.evidence: The chart displays nine language family categories on the x-axis, not eight.
The label for the category on the x-axis is "IE-Slavic". The word "family" is the label for the entire x-axis, not part of this specific category's name.

errors.text_span: in the IE-Indic family, the tallest bar is mBERT-R₂ (light green) with an effect of approximately 20, followed closely by mBERT-B₂ (light pink) at about 22
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the tallest bar and the ordering for the IE-Indic family. The tallest bar is mBERT-B₂ (light pink) with a value of approximately 24. The second tallest is XLM-B2 (dark red) at ~21, and the third is mBERT-R₂ (light green) at ~20.5.

errors.text_span: while the shortest bars are mBERT-L₂ (light blue) and XLM-L₂ (dark blue), both at approximately 1
errors.evidence: For the IE-Indic family, the bar for XLM-L₂ (dark blue) is not at approximately 1; it has a negative value of approximately -2.

errors.text_span: In the Semitic family, the tallest bar is XLM-B₂ (dark red) at approximately 20, followed by XLM-L₂ (dark blue) at about 15, and mBERT-L₂ (light blue) at approximately 10.
errors.evidence: This description of the bars for the Semitic family is entirely incorrect. The tallest bar is XLM-L₂ (dark blue) with a value of approximately 25. The second tallest is XLM-B₂ (dark red) with a value of about 19. The description misidentifies the tallest bar and misreports the values and ordering of the other bars.
